packages.name: WayriCAD BOM Studio
packages.description: Review component fields, stage BOM edits, and export purchasing or assembly tables.
packages.description_full: WayriCAD BOM Studio opens the originating KiCad project for local component review, staged field edits, and purchasing or assembly BOM exports. Five primary views keep the workflow focused; variants, catalogues, checks and other advanced tools remain available. Supports native KiCad field/grouping/format preferences, CSV/XLSX/TSV and reviewed assembler mappings. No automatic purchasing or upload. Native desktop web view with a local browser fallback; first-time dependency setup may require internet access. Linux/macOS native desktop and KiCad 11 acceptance remain unverified.

packages.name: WayriCAD Bulk Label Editor
packages.description: Bulk edit labels, PCB text, footprint references, values, and fields with wildcard or regex rules.
packages.description_full: WayriCAD Bulk Label Editor provides a safe preview-and-apply workflow for renaming repeated channel labels and component text inside KiCad. It supports wildcard captures such as CH*_MAIN -> CH*_REDUNDANT, regex replacements, and scoped edits for references, values, fields, and PCB text.

packages.name: WayriCAD Copper Balancer
packages.description: Preview isolated copper thieving and local density balancing on saved PCB copies.
packages.description_full: Local native KiCad 10 polygon geometry, eight patterns, per-layer density maps, clearances, keepouts and replacement. The PCM action opens an explicit saved-board workflow and writes a new board copy. Live IPC copper edits and KiCad 11 geometry are not yet supported.

packages.name: WayriCAD Embed3D
packages.description: Create project-local footprint, symbol and 3D libraries with reviewed links and a backup.
packages.description_full: A compact Preview → Localize workflow creates configurable project-local footprint and symbol libraries, copies linked 3D models, updates saved design references and library tables, and publishes only after native validation. Original files have a timestamped backup and changed inputs invalidate the preview. Additional model folders and path variables are remembered per project. The independent native window allows closing source editors before applying. Advanced embedding, extraction, relinking and standalone footprint-file tools remain available under More. Uses installed KiCad native helpers for geometry normalization; KiCad 11 compatibility is not certified.

packages.name: WayriCAD Extract Pins
packages.description: Modeless pin extraction, PCB cross-selection, visual diagrams, and interboard documentation for KiCad.
packages.description_full:
WayriCAD provides a focused, modeless Pin Extractor plus a separate Interboard & Harness workspace.

**Features:**
- Follow live PCB selection while the extractor remains open
- Combine selected footprints with comma-separated wildcard reference, net, and value filters
- Resolve wildcard label families to selected IC/connector pins through user-approved series components
- Build safeguarded controller/IC-to-connector maps across exact inline pin pairs and renamed nets
- Support opt-in conditional MOSFET, BJT, jumper-state, and other IC crossings without inferring device state or direction
- Export source/connector pins, pin functions, net sequences, intermediate components, ordered traces, confidence, and ambiguity status
- Define shared power, supply, ground, and forced-signal wildcard rules
- Highlight named nets or select their routed tracks, vias, and zones
- Review native pin tables before deterministic CSV or Markdown export
- Consolidate repeated pad links into explicit source/path/destination routes
- Generate embedded IC signal-flow charts and checked converter/filter power trees
- Explore interactive system maps, signal topologies, and power-flow diagrams with unique component cards and color-coded net buses
- Zoom, pan, fit, and click diagram nets to cross-highlight them in PCB Editor
- Build a networkx connectivity graph from pcbnew board data and optional KiCad XML netlists
- Preserve hierarchical sheet paths and apply user-defined path/reference aliases
- Import pin documents from other projects and auto-link board-level endpoints
- Apply exact, normalized, wildcard, or regex link rules and flag ambiguous matches
- Export cross-project trackers, harness SVGs, ICDs, test-point traces, and TM/TC tables
- Check and install full-suite dependencies through an integrated guarded manager
- Run deterministic inspect, extract, crosslink, validate, report, benchmark, and test commands outside KiCad

Optional Python packages for full dashboard capability: networkx, matplotlib, markdown, and Pillow. The integrated dependency manager installs reviewed packages into KiCad's Python user-site.

Targets KiCAD 9 and later.

packages.name: WayriCAD Fanout Generator
packages.description: Preview and generate advanced SMD, BGA, and LGA fanouts with persistent grouped commits.
packages.description_full: Local, reviewable routing with configurable geometry, pad/net scope, clearance checks, zoomable preview, shared headless planners, and recoverable named commit groups. Preview does not modify PCB copper. JSON/SVG command-line planning and verified application write a new board copy.

packages.name: WayriCAD Harness and Cable Workbench
packages.description: Build multi-board harness maps, drawings, bundles, splices, and BoMs.
packages.description_full: Imports up to 50 board pin CSV documents, maps arbitrary connector pins, bundles, splices, gauges, and loads, and joins safeguarded Pin Extractor controller maps into complete IC-to-IC or IC-to-peripheral routes through series components. Exports sortable tables, CSV, SVG, an offline pan/zoom/draggable interactive system harness, findings, and a procurement BoM.

packages.name: WayriCAD PCB / Foil Heater Designer
packages.description: Design zoned PCB heaters and preview electrical and thermal behavior.
packages.description_full: Generate serpentine or spiral multilayer heater copper, vary resistance by region to create controlled hot/cold zones, run a review-grade thermal model, and commit only the reviewed geometry.

packages.name: WayriCAD Manufacturing Readiness Manager
packages.description: Audit fabricator capabilities and gate deterministic KiCad manufacturing releases.
packages.description_full: Combines reusable fabricator capability profiles with board geometry audits, KiCad JSON DRC and jobset execution, explicit pass/fail release gates, and ZIP packaging with SHA-256 file manifests. It does not claim fabricator acceptance; profiles must be reviewed against the current fabrication quotation.

packages.name: WayriCAD Mechanical Check
packages.description: Local mechanical clearance, height, hardware and STEP interference review.
packages.description_full: Read-only saved-board mechanical validation, exact FreeCAD/Open CASCADE solid intersections, model coverage inventory, native conflict viewer and offline HTML/JSON/CSV reports. Requires an installed KiCad 10 Python/CLI and FreeCAD Python. IPC launch opens the saved file; it does not capture unsaved edits. KiCad 11 launch is forward-oriented and unverified; the extraction worker still requires KiCad 10.

packages.name: WayriCAD PDN and Decoupling Planner
packages.description: Audit power-rail topology and local decoupling placement from PCB geometry.
packages.description_full: Uses configurable rail, ground, capacitor, load, and regulator conventions to locate supply pins without nearby rail-to-ground capacitors. Results are sortable, cross-selectable, and exportable. It is a placement/topology screen rather than an AC impedance, transient, or electromagnetic PDN solver.

packages.name: WayriCAD Planar Magnetics & Actuator Workbench
packages.description: Design PCB coils, transformers, inductors, motors, actuators, and magnetic torquers.
packages.description_full: Generate multilayer and via-connected planar windings, estimate LCR, loss, field and force, then simulate coupled current, position, speed, acceleration, resonance, damping, travel stops, and thermal-noise limits for linear and rotary actuator concepts.

packages.name: WayriCAD Protocol Constraint Composer
packages.description: Detect protocol nets and compose reviewed KiCad custom design rules.
packages.description_full: Detects common USB, CAN, Ethernet, PCIe/SerDes, DDR, RS-485, and RF net-name conventions, presents editable assignments, and generates a clearly delimited WayriCAD-managed custom-rule block. Rules can be exported or applied to the project .kicad_dru after confirmation and timestamped backup.

packages.name: WayriCAD Quick PI
packages.description: Local 2.5D power-integrity simulation with source/sink terminals, copper meshes and native result views.
packages.description_full: Solve DC voltage drop, current density and Joule loss on actual filled traces, pads, zones and plated via barrels. Inspect net geometry, conforming mesh and field results in a native window; export a self-contained HTML report. Includes current/energy checks, explicit stackup and plating inputs, and a pulse-duration temperature-risk screen. KiCad 10 native Python with NumPy, SciPy, VTK and Matplotlib is required. This is a layered DC model, not a full-wave AC or thermal-field solver.

packages.name: WayriCAD Return-Path Auditor
packages.description: Find PCB return-path discontinuities, unsupported layer transitions, plane gaps, and possible routed stubs.
packages.description_full: A modeless, read-only geometry audit for routed signal segments. It checks signal-via proximity to configured return vias, supplied return-plane coverage, and branched copper that may form stubs. Findings are cross-selectable and exportable. Results are review aids, not electromagnetic simulation or compliance certification.

packages.name: WayriCAD Signal Integrity Advisor
packages.description: Calculate I2C pull-up ranges and validate routed single-ended or differential impedance.
packages.description_full: Guided, read-only engineering checks for I2C pull-up resistance, routed impedance, differential skew, stackup/reference-layer use, vias, layer changes, zones, and unresolved topology. Includes editable protocol presets for CAN, Ethernet, RF, RS-485, SerDes, USB 2/3/4, and custom constraints.

packages.name: WayriCAD Test Point Descriptor Extractor
packages.description: Resolve test points through passives to IC pins and export engineering documentation.
packages.description_full: Scans TP and TestPoint footprints, extracts descriptor/function fields, traces connected nets through common passives and NetTie_Path parts to terminal IC pins, parses board-sequence TM/TC labels, sorts and consolidates reviewed rows, and exports documentation, spring-probe channel plans, or a separate KiCad bed-of-nails fixture PCB.

packages.name: WayriCAD Trace RLC / Impedance Analyzer
packages.description: Measure routed geometry and estimate RLC and impedance against an explicit reference layer.
packages.description_full: Follows PCB net and pad selection, traverses the routed path between endpoints, enumerates the complete parsed stackup, and reports route geometry, vias, layer changes, resistance, capacitance, inductance, and first-order impedance with the exact reference layer, dielectric height, and permittivity used.

packages.name: WayriCAD Design Variant Workbench
packages.description: Review, edit, validate, compare, audit, and release KiCad 10 design variants safely.
packages.description_full: WayriCAD Design Variant Workbench provides semantic Set Default/rebase operations, a variant matrix, comparison and lint tables, PCB synchronization audits, guarded part substitutions, lifecycle management, and manufacturing-release generation. A native PCB Editor ActionPlugin passes the active project to a detached workbench so KiCad can be closed before Apply. Every design-file write requires a preview, rejects active KiCad lock files and stale input hashes, validates generated S-expressions, creates all backups before writing, uses atomic replacement, and attempts rollback on failure.

packages.name: WayriCAD Via Stitching
packages.description: Preview net-aware copper-zone via stitching with geometric clearance exclusions.
packages.description_full: Local, reviewable routing with configurable geometry, pad/net scope, clearance checks, zoomable preview, shared headless planners, and recoverable named commit groups. Preview does not modify PCB copper. JSON/SVG command-line planning and verified application write a new board copy.

packages.name: WayriCAD Visual Diff
packages.description: Compare PCB and schematic Git revisions with native KiCad SVGs in a local interactive report.
packages.description_full: Minimal local launcher for saved Git revisions. Compare sheets and PCB layers side by side, overlay, swipe, or inspect a raster change map with shared coordinates and pan/zoom. Offline HTML reports bundle all assets. Includes CLI and optional, separately invoked GitHub integration. Requires Git and KiCad 10+ CLI; does not modify boards or include unsaved editor changes. IPC only discovers the current saved board path; future KiCad compatibility is unverified.
